name: Malta

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 574250 inhabitants, recorded as 0.574 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained. The School of Performing Arts of the University of Malta, the country's only higher education structure in the field, offers a bachelor's in Theatre Studies with English, a bachelor's in Performing Arts combining dance, music and theatre, and a master's in Theatre and Performance. No puppetry stream or specialism. Upper bound raised from 0 to 1, the curricula not having been read unit by unit. Estimate.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
